before.requirement: Complete single-call decompression of the 63,241-byte fixed-Huffman zlib stream using the previous tree-clearing operation.
before.reason: The previous decoder accepts the header and builds fixed Huffman trees, but the old harness supplies at most 63,240 output bytes and makes no retry.

after.requirement: Complete single-call decompression of the same 63,241-byte fixed-Huffman zlib stream using the new tree-clearing helper.
after.reason: The new helper is called during fixed-Huffman tree construction, while the same harness capacity remains below the required output size.

claims.reason: Both versions parse the same header and build fixed Huffman trees. The old harness derives the same insufficient capacity from the first two bytes on both sides; the changed clearing operation does not alter that constraint.
